metadata.title: 80s Synth-Pop Album Cover with Hype Sticker

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait paired with vibrant, multi-colored brushstroke text and a blue geometric hype sticker.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with wet-look hair and ornate jewelry, set against a dark background. The composition is interrupted by three horizontal, textured paint strokes in yellow, pink, and purple containing sans-serif text, and a tilted blue rectangular sticker with yellow and white typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. vibrant graphic overlays
Organic brushstroke textures vs. geometric sticker shape
High-contrast lighting vs. flat graphic elements
Diagonal eye path from top-left text to bottom-right jewelry
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for the subject
Textured, multi-colored horizontal brushstrokes as text containers
A tilted blue rectangular 'hype sticker' element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close portrait, centered horizontally but leaning towards the right, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright blue hype sticker in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the colorful brushstrokes, moves to the blue sticker, then follows the subject's gaze and hand placement down to the ornate bracelets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space in the upper right and left corners provides breathing room for the graphic elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements against zero saturation in the photographic base.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Use of '+' symbols as spacers or decorative elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights and colors to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric structure for the sticker text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with wet-look hair and ornate jewelry against a dark background. Include three horizontal textured paint strokes (yellow, pink, purple) in the top left and a tilted blue rounded rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric sans-serif uppercase text over the brushstrokes and inside the blue sticker using white, black, and yellow colors as appropriate.

verificationChecks: Are the brushstrokes textured and vibrant?
Is the blue sticker tilted at an angle?
Is the typography a clean geometric sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Ensure text is legible against brushstroke textures
Verify the 'sticker' looks like a separate physical element
Confirm the plus signs are used as decorative spacers
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Neon Brushstroke Overlays + Tilted Hype Sticker = 80s New Wave Aesthetic
